memory_candidates.content: When planning a new Lean module inside an existing namespace cluster, compile the plan's sorry-bodied Challenge statements with the WHOLE cluster imported (every sibling module, not just the new module's own import list) before pinning them. A standalone research probe written in its own namespace (Probe566, Probe565) cannot see same-namespace name collisions: FormalSystem.Semantics.Presheaf.ofWorld (Directed.lean) and states_eq_of_eq (Sheaf.lean) were each found this way at plan time, one dispatch before they would have been duplicate-declaration errors in the root closure. Second lesson from the same compile: a def whose value later statements rely on definitionally (absObj t).val = |t| cannot be pinned with a sorry body; restate dependent lemmas over the unfolded form and pin the def's content as a separate spec lemma.
